'''3V-1L''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Umbral]] in his [[Master's Top Secret Army]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:CoF" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
3V-1L first appeared in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
